hero.headline: AUTOMATIC LEVEL BOSCH
hero.title: Bosch Automatic Level – Reliable Levelling Instruments
hero.description: SmartGrid Surveying supplies high-quality Bosch automatic levels for precise height measurements and levelling tasks in construction, surveying, and engineering projects.

productOverview.headline: Bosch Automatic Level
productOverview.description: Bosch automatic levels are known for their accuracy, durability, and ease of use. Designed for construction sites and surveying applications, these instruments provide reliable height readings and leveling reference points for a wide range of projects.

items.title: High Accuracy
items.description: Precision levelling with standard deviation of ±1 mm per km (double run).

items.title: Magnification
items.description: Bright, clear optics with 24x – 32x magnification for accurate sighting.

items.title: Durable Design
items.description: Robust construction with water and dust resistance for field use.

items.title: Easy to Use
items.description: Magnetic damper compensator for quick and stable leveling.
